answer: Clone accounts are an ocean: vast, cheap, and shallow. A real reputation is a canyon - it takes time and flowing work to carve, and it cannot be faked overnight. Make standing crystal clear by pricing it in countersigned deeds: each epoch answer, each honest grade, each attested transaction is a layer of rock a fresh identity simply has not lived through. Sybils can copy words, but they cannot copy a long, verifiable history of distinct work.
